title: tune-nccl-streams-and-scheduling-to-improve-overlap-tensor-parallel
author: Arjun Patel
description: Motivation: on multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads we observed significant GPU idle time caused by blocking NCCL collectives and suboptimal scheduling of compute vs communication. For long-sequence generation (seq=1024-2048) this manifests as per-token stalls and lower achieved throughput compared to expected roofline. This PR introduces a set of complementary changes to improve overlap of communication and compute for tensor-parallel sharded models: 1) explicit separation of compute vs comm CUDA streams and an async NCCL wrapper to avoid implicit stream synchronization; 2) an adaptive scheduling policy that reorders gradients/kv-allgather vs local compute to maximize overlap based on runtime-profiled per-layer cost; 3) NCCL tuning knobs (env/config) and a small parameter sampler used in CI to pick better algorithm heuristics for common topologies; 4) KV-cache placement adjustments so that key/value chunking aligns with TP shard boundaries to reduce cross-GPU allgather sizes; 5) continuous-batching tweak: extend batch-formation window slightly for TP mode to reduce tiny-batch collectives. The description below summarizes changes, testing, and results. Changes summary: - runtime/tensor_parallel/scheduler.py: new AdaptiveOverlapScheduler that profiles layer compute/comm and schedules non-blocking collectives on dedicated comm stream. - runtime/tensor_parallel/nccl_tuning.py: new helper that sets nccl async progress flags, creates per-rank comm contexts and exposes environment knobs for deploy-time tuning. - runtime/kv_cache/placement.py: align-kv-chunks option; reduces cross-shard allgather by ~20% for common model dims. - runtime/batching/continuous_batcher.py: TP-aware batching window configuration. - tests/integration/test_tp_nccl_overlap.py: integration test that asserts overlap percentage and end-to-end throughput for synthetic and real model trace. - docs/perf/notes-tp-nccl-tuning.md: guidance for operators on knobs and tradeoffs. Checklist: - [x] Implement scheduler and nccl helpers - [x] Unit tests for scheduler logic - [x] Integration benchmark and perf numbers - [x] Docs for operators - [x] Post-merge smoke job gated for Dedicated clusters Notes: we intentionally keep defaults conservative (no behavior change for existing customers unless feature flag enabled via config: runtime.tensor_parallel.enable_overlap_tuning=true). This reduces risk for Dedicated/Private deployments while allowing experimentation in hosted and test clusters. Related: ENG-3214 (profiling), ENG-3289 (kv-cache placement), perf canary runs linked in internal dashboard.

review_comments: Priya Rao: Nice end-to-end, can you add a comment explaining why we allocate a comm stream per module instead of reusing a pool?

Arjun Patel: Reply: we tried a shared pool but observed cross-stream synchronization due to implicit stream waits from some kernels; per-module gives more predictable isolation and the memory cost is small. Added comments and a small micro-benchmark in tests.
Ethan Liu: Integration looks good, but FP16 kernel paths need verification. Also please add a fallback when nccl async progress is unavailable (older drivers).
Arjun Patel: Added FP16-run in canary and a driver-check in nccl_tuning to gracefully disable async progress; updated docs with driver version matrix.
Sofia Martínez: Approved after nit fixes. Verified throughput numbers on 8xA100 cluster and code looks safe behind feature flag. Left suggestion to expose the tuning sampler via internal admin UI.

release_notes: Performance: improved communication/compute overlap for tensor-parallel workloads. Expect ~15-25% throughput improvement for long-sequence autoregressive generation on 4-8 GPU TP configs. Feature is behind runtime.tensor_parallel.enable_overlap_tuning (disabled by default).
perf_benchmarks: 8x A100 80GB, model: redwood-3b, batch=8, seq=2048: throughput +18%, p50 latency -12%, overlap fraction +30 percentage points
4x A100, model: redwood-1b, batch=16, seq=1024: throughput +12%, memory overhead +3% (streams/contexts)
8x V100 (legacy): no regression when async progress disabled; small gains (<5%) when enabled and driver supports it
notes: We intentionally added conservative defaults and a gating flag. Ops / Dedicated teams should coordinate to enable wire-wide. Follow-up work: extend autotuner to pick per-layer algorithm (ncclAlgo) and integrate with pod placement heuristics. Hotfix plan: revert by flipping runtime.tensor_parallel.enable_overlap_tuning=false if any cluster-level regressions are seen.
